name: komoot
description: List and inspect Komoot tours, download GPX or FIT, and rename planned tours through the local Safari cookie session.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect, export, and rename Komoot tours.
interface.longDescription: Local MCP tools use the curl-safari Unix socket to access Komoot with the existing Safari login, list tours, read metadata or full route geometry or native tour-line geometry, save GPX and FIT exports to the training-ai workspace, and rename owned planned tours with explicit confirmation and readback.
capabilities: List planned and recorded tours with filtering and pagination
Read tour metadata separately from full route geometry
Download a Komoot tour as a validated GPX or FIT file
Rename an owned planned tour with explicit confirmation and readback verification
Use Safari cookies in memory through curl-safari's Unix socket
Inspect way types, surfaces and warnings by distance along the route
Compare route geometry with another tour or external coordinates
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the Komoot MCP to list tours, read metadata or full route geometry or native tour-line geometry, export GPX or FIT, or rename an owned planned tour with confirmation.
